story: A small bird finds a seed before a storm and learns to ask for help.
message: Preparation and cooperation turn a small effort into safety.

platform.primary_audience: Adults and parents who enjoy concise illustrated fables with a reusable takeaway.

aspect_decision.reason: Compose faces, the seed, the storm, captions, and the final decision card for a native vertical feed.

social_contract.editorial_promise: Show that a tiny preparation becomes useful only when the bird asks for help, then leave a reusable cooperation check.
social_contract.familiarity_gap: The audience may know cooperation is good; the episode shows the specific moment when solitary preparation must become a shared action.

opening.first_frame_event: Wind tears through the grass as the bird and seed are already at risk.
opening.first_spoken_line: 一颗种子，为什么要两只鸟才能救下来？
opening.cover_to_opening_match: The cover shows the seed, two birds, and the incoming storm; the first frame begins that same danger.

value.transferable_insight: Preparation becomes resilient when ownership, help, and the next action are explicit.
value.modern_connection: Use the same check when a small task is too fragile for one person to protect alone.

packaging.episode_title: 一颗种子，为什么需要两只鸟？
packaging.cover_copy:
一颗种子
两只鸟来救
packaging.pinned_question: 你最近哪件事，真正需要另一个人一起完成？

animatic.review_notes: Opening risk, full causal edit, and final three-question card are readable with scratch audio and muted.

audience_layers.immediate_read: A child or fast-scrolling viewer immediately reads one vulnerable seed, an approaching storm, and two birds choosing to protect it together.
audience_layers.adult_reward: Adults notice the shift from isolated ownership to shared responsibility, credible bird behavior, restrained botanical detail, and the opening storm shape returning as a protective nest arc.

visual_direction.emotional_promise: Move from exposed fragility and cold pressure to active cooperation and enclosed warmth.
visual_direction.collectible_frame_goal: The final three-question card remains useful as a standalone image while the two birds and sheltered seed visually complete the story.
visual_direction.undesirable_impression: Reject generic AI children's-book art, a museum slide, muddy antique filtering, decorative cutouts, or a mobile-game-ad finish.

shape_language.heroes: round and enclosing ovals with asymmetric gesture
shape_language.threat: narrow wind diagonals and broken grass rhythms
shape_language.environment: large calm fields with one readable middle-ground corridor
shape_language.critical_props: simple complete silhouettes with tactile construction

value_design.focal_subject: bird-seed contact, then the shared leaf over the nest
value_design.subject_background_separation: Warm light figures sit one clear value step above the cool gray-green field; the seed receives the brightest small accent.
value_design.mass_policy: One large environment mass, one medium actor relationship, and one small high-contrast decision object.

color_script.accent_policy: Reserve vermilion-brown for the seed and final decision marks; do not scatter equal saturation through the scenery.
color_script.emotional_arc: Opening is cool and desaturated; cooperation introduces warm cream; the ending balances jade and ochre inside a warmer enclosure.

line_and_texture.line_rule: Fine controlled ink at faces and contacts; lighter, softer edges with depth.
line_and_texture.texture_rule: Smooth silk-like washes with sparse botanical grain at a scale that survives phone display.

lighting_and_depth.key_light: Soft upper-left light remains coherent through both shots; storm shadow cools the opposite side.
lighting_and_depth.depth_plan: Foreground grass uses selective dark overlap, actors remain crisp in the middle ground, and distant foliage loses contrast and edge detail.
lighting_and_depth.contact_shadow_policy: Small restrained shadows attach feet, seed, leaf, and nest to their declared support surfaces.

composition.big_medium_small: Unequal environment, actor-pair, and seed/nest masses; no evenly spaced decorative repetition.
composition.negative_space: Reserve wind direction and gaze space ahead of the birds, then close that space around the protected seed.
composition.phone_focal_point: The primary face-to-object or beak-to-load contact remains identifiable at normal vertical-feed size.
composition.subtitle_integration: Bottom-center captions sit over a deliberately quiet value field and never cover bird, seed, leaf, or nest contact.

visual_direction.signature: Threatening diagonal grass gradually bends into the same enclosing arc used by the leaf and final question card.

route_candidates.differentiator: Fine ink, silk-like washes, shallow theatrical depth, and warm/cool restraint.
route_candidates.strengths: Supports emotion, cultural tactility, and readable character acting.
route_candidates.risks: Can become pale or museum-like if value hierarchy is weak.
route_candidates.audience_impression: Gentle, crafted, literary, and contemporary enough for a phone feed.

route_candidates.differentiator: Large cut silhouettes, harder theatrical light, and very sparse texture.
route_candidates.strengths: Excellent small-screen readability and energetic threat shapes.
route_candidates.risks: May lose tenderness and botanical specificity.

route_candidates.differentiator: Atmospheric watercolor fields, selective ink detail, and deeper weather perspective.
route_candidates.strengths: Strong storm mood and adult visual reward.
route_candidates.risks: Characters may dissolve into low-contrast scenery.

lookdev.selection_rationale: It best preserves phone-size action clarity while supporting warmth, cultural craft, and a collectible ending; route B is too blunt and route C risks weak character separation.

characters.description: A small ochre paper-cut bird with a round body and indigo wing tips.

identity_model_pack.scale_reference: One approved body-height unit from crown to grounded foot baseline.
identity_model_pack.asymmetry_notes: Indigo wing-tip pattern and eye highlights must remain side-correct; do not infer direction from filename alone.
identity_model_pack.expression_range: Neutral, alert, worried, effort, relief; preserve beak and eye construction.
identity_model_pack.attachment_rules: Feet attach to the ground baseline; beak and both wing roots have named contact points.

stable_traits.silhouette: round ochre body with short beak

characters.description: A slightly larger jade-green paper-cut bird with a long tail and warm cream chest.

identity_model_pack.scale_reference: 1.18 bird body-height units on the same grounded baseline.
identity_model_pack.asymmetry_notes: Long tail sweep and jade wing marking remain side-correct; preserve warm-cream chest placement.
identity_model_pack.expression_range: Neutral, attentive, effort, reassurance, relief; preserve the longer beak and eye spacing.
identity_model_pack.attachment_rules: Feet share the project ground baseline; beak, wing roots, and tail base have named pivots.

stable_traits.silhouette: slender jade body with long tail

scenes.title: 发现种子
scenes.narrative_goal: The bird travels from screen left to screen right, notices a seed, and lifts it.
scenes.narration: 暴雨来临前，小鸟在路边发现了一颗种子。

action.proof: The seed leaves the ground and remains visibly controlled by the bird.

events.action: The bird notices and lifts the seed.
events.propagation: The seed changes owner from ground to bird.
events.result: The bird starts looking for shelter.
events.proof: The seed visibly leaves the ground and is held by the bird while clouds gather.

visual_beats.change: Wind bends the grass and puts the bird and seed in immediate danger.
The bird notices the exposed seed and changes direction.
The beak reaches the seed while the storm closes in.
The seed leaves the ground under the bird's control.
The bird looks off-screen for help.

scenes.title: 一起筑巢
scenes.narrative_goal: Two birds carry one leaf from screen right to screen left and cover the nest.
scenes.narration: 它叫来伙伴，一起把种子藏进温暖的巢里。

action.proof: The leaf reaches and visibly covers the nest.
Both birds stay attached to one leaf until it covers the nest.

ensemble_actions.proof: Both birds visibly grip the same leaf while placing it over the nest.

events.action: Two birds carry one leaf together.
events.propagation: The leaf crosses the frame and lowers over the nest.
events.result: The seed remains dry inside the nest.
events.proof: Both birds contact the same leaf and the final leaf visibly covers the nest.

visual_beats.change: The helper enters and both birds take one leaf.
Their shared load crosses toward the nest.
The leaf begins to lower over the seed.
The seed is visibly covered and dry.
The three-question decision card begins its measured readable hold.

scenes.long_hold_rationale: The final 4.2-second still card is the declared save object; narration pauses so all three questions can be read at feed size.
